title: Seeing Seeds Beyond Weeds: Green Teaming Generative AI for Beneficial Uses
findings: The paper cites prior work (Abid et al., 2021) which found that some Large Generative Models have replicated harmful content such as anti-Muslim rhetoric. This finding is used as a background example of a known harm that current content filters aim to prevent, rather than a new finding from this paper.
